name: Ninjago Tournament Vita
author: reallootfury
description:
An Android ARMv7 compatibility port of LEGO Ninjago Tournament using vitaGL. Release version: 1.00 (Vita SFO 01.00).
Progressive player/boss heart depletion is confirmed working on a physical Vita. The release keeps that renderer fix and provides separate normal and logging-enabled packages; the packaging/logging changes need a device smoke test. Loading delays and occasional gameplay stutters remain known limitations.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
